name: Tulsyan NEC Limited
summary: Tulsyan NEC Limited is a manufacturing enterprise primarily focused on producing thermo-mechanically treated (TMT) bars, as well as an array of synthetic woven fabrics and sacks. The company organizes its operations across four distinct divisions: Steel, Synthetic, Power, and Media. Its extensive product offerings feature TMT bars, sponge iron, billets, ingots, polypropylene woven sacks, flexible intermediate bulk containers (FIBCs), and various types of woven fabric. Established on April 11, 1947, Tulsyan NEC Limited maintains its headquarters in Chennai, India.
